svg.title: SmartHire request, processing and data architecture
svg.desc: Web requests and responses through gateway and service APIs; owned storage; Temporal publication and scoring; RabbitMQ and Celery tasks; service exchanges and Kafka reporting.

g.text: PROPOSED · Solid purple: request / response · Blue: background work · Dashed grey: owned data
RabbitMQ boxes share one logical broker. Temporal boxes share one Temporal Service.
APIs and workers share their service-owned data. Candidate owns resume files; Job owns description files. Physical storage layout is open.
Identity reporting uses reconciliation. Observability: OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana. Redis / NoSQL roles remain open.
